name: Route Board: travels, cabs and buses
author: Claude (Get4Domain design)
description: Highway-green and signal-orange theme for travel operators: bus-front hero with scrolling LED destination board, service tiles, ticket-style package cards, season and pilgrimage milestones, fleet and rates, booking route steps.

marketplace.licence: Theme code: for use by Get4Domain vendors on their vendor websites. Illustrations are original vector art made for this theme. Fonts Lora and Inter: SIL OFL 1.1.
